title: Geometric Steel Sculpture, 1970s Urban City B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white photograph depicting a large, intricate geometric framework structure made of repeating triangular shapes. Shot from a dramatic perspective looking through another structural frame, the artwork or construction piece appears to be mounted on a flatbed trailer in a downtown urban area. In the background, a mid-century multi-story office building with uniform windows and vintage late 1960s to early 1970s cars are visible along the street, reflecting the modernist public art movement of the era.
